Thank you, Mr. President. Second case study, yung Cale88. Ito rin eh, yung authorized capital, stock, 2 million. Pero yung kanilang aggregate total sales, 208 million from 2022 hanggang 2025. Inaalok po namin ang kanyang testimonya bilang expert at para patunayan ang mga sumusunod. Una po, na-qualified siya to follow the money and reconcile the financial records. The witness possesses the education, professional qualifications, specialized training, experience and technical expertise necessary to examine financial records, trace transactions, reconcile income and assets, analyze financial relationships, and identify material discrepancies among financial documents. Sa madaling salita, your honors, expertise po niya ang sundan ang pera. Number two, he examined the respondent statements of assets, liabilities, and net worth or SALNs, income tax returns, and other tax records, bank records, anti-money laundering reports, corporate documents, audited financial statements, and other subpoenaed official or publicly available records. Three, he used recognized financial and accounting methods to test whether these records reconcile. The witness applies recognized methods of financial analysis, reconciliation, transaction tracing, and accounting analysis to compare the respondents' documented income and sources of funds against their assets, financial transactions, investments, and business interests. Fourth, based on the foregoing, the witness arrived at the following conclusions. One, Vice President Sara Duterte-SALN for the years 2022. 2023, 2024, and 2025 were untruthful with a substantial amount of assets belonging to the respondent and spouse found to be unreported. Second, Vice President Sara Duterte, during her vice presidency, continued to participate in various businesses. Third, her unexplained wealth, based only on the limited documents examined, excluding documents in the possession of Vice President Sara and spouse, amount to 818.87 million pesos. Fourth, the above-mentioned infringements which happened in 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2025 established a pattern of constitutional violations year on year. And fifth, apart from the Constitution, other laws were violated or may have been violated such as the National Internal Revenue Code, Republic Act 1379, Republic Act 6713, Republic Act 3019, Republic Act 12009, Securities and Regulations Code Rules, and Commission Audit Rules. We will establish, Your Honor, ng aming testigo ay mapagkakatiwalaan dahil siya ay may integridad. Hindi po siya yung tipong expert na pinulot lang kung saan saan. His credentials and trustworthiness are, in our view, impeccable. Ito po ang magiging ambag ng expert witness na ito. The other witnesses in this article presented the underlying records. SALN, corporate records from the SEC, records for firearms from the Philippine National Police, records of the Anti-Money Laundering Council, banks and insurance companies, and the Bureau of Internal Revenue. Atty. Cabrera will connect the dots and provide this court. with the big picture. That is all for the offer, Your Honor.

Pero ang pagkakaiba po nito ay pinagtatagpi-tagpi niyo po yung mga dokumentong iyon para malaman po ang katotohanan base po sa kwento na inyong matutunghayan. So ito pong forensic audit ay kadalasan po ginagamit po ito sa courts. Ginagamit po ito privately pagka meron pong nag-i-invest po halimbawa sa isang kumpanya para malaman nung investor kung may problema yung kumpanya talaga pagka meron silang nabalitaan na may nangyayaring katiwalian dun sa kumpanya niyan. Tsaka ginagamit din po ito ng mga litigants po para po makakolekta sa mga stockholder po na may-ari po ng kumpanya. Para po ma-pierce po ba yung veil na tinatawag at maging liable hindi lang po yung corporation kung hindi po yung mga stockholders directly po.

I'm reading it verbatim. "In any case where the opinion of an expert witness is received in evidence, the court has a wide latitude of discretion in determining the weight to be given to such opinion, and for that purpose may consider the following."
